title: Concept: Diagnostic page exposed via phpinfo in php — review required
description: In php, phpinfo is called. The output includes configuration values, enabled extensions, environment variables and absolute paths, which is precisely the reconnaissance an attacker would otherwise have to guess. It also confirms the exact patch level, so version-specific exploits can be selected without probing.
applicability: php applications that still ship a diagnostic page.
risk: Version and configuration disclosure, including environment secrets; MEDIUM severity.
